role.werewolf.desc: Choose prey with your pack at night and hide among the village by day.
role.villager.desc: Read the room, vote carefully, and uncover the wolves among you.
role.seer.desc: Discover one player's alignment each night.
role.witch.desc: You have one antidote and one poison. Each can be used only once.
role.hunter.desc: When you die, you may take one living player with you.
role.werewolf.timing: Choose one non-wolf target with the pack every night.
role.werewolf.goal: Reach parity with all other living players.
role.villager.timing: No night skill. Discuss and vote during the day.
role.villager.goal: Help the good team identify and eliminate every wolf.
role.seer.timing: Inspect one living player every night.
role.seer.goal: Protect your information and guide the good team to the wolves.
role.witch.timing: After the wolves act, use the antidote, poison, or skip.
role.witch.goal: Use both potions carefully to help eliminate every wolf.
role.hunter.timing: When an eligible death triggers your shot, target one living player.
role.hunter.goal: Take down a wolf at the crucial moment and help the good team win.

guide.title: Boards and role skills
board.classic.name: Moonlit Classic
board.classic.desc: A balanced mix of villagers and power roles for most groups.
board.classic.long: Seer, Witch, and Hunter enter gradually as the group grows. Information, rescue plays, and deduction all have room to matter.
board.beginner.name: Morning Mist
board.beginner.desc: Lower early skill density keeps new players focused on discussion and voting.
board.beginner.long: Small groups keep the Witch as a safety valve, then add Seer and Hunter as player count rises. More Villagers make the rules easier to learn.
board.power.name: Crimson Moon
board.power.desc: Strong roles such as Hunter arrive earlier and swing the village faster.
board.power.long: The three-player setup pits Werewolf, Witch, and Hunter against each other immediately. Seer and Villagers join later for experienced groups that enjoy risky decisions.
